items.name: Sum of deficits
items.description: Sum deficits from a target value or threshold.

items.name: Ceiling division
items.description: Integer ceiling division for counts or operation requirements.

items.name: Modular arithmetic
items.description: Modular arithmetic operations or identities.

items.name: Convolution
items.description: Combine coefficient sequences by polynomial or distribution convolution.

items.name: Concave convolution
items.description: Exploit concavity or monotone slopes to merge DP sequences faster than naive max-plus convolution.

items.name: Number theoretic transform
items.description: Use NTT-friendly modular convolution for polynomial or sequence multiplication.

items.name: Generating function
items.description: Encode counts or probabilities as coefficients of a generating function.

items.name: Formal power series
items.description: Manipulate formal power series with polynomial arithmetic, inverses, products, or coefficient extraction.

items.name: Bostan-Mori
items.description: Extract coefficients of rational generating functions with Bostan-Mori even/odd polynomial reductions.

items.name: Linear recurrence
items.description: Model a sequence by a linear recurrence or rational generating function to compute distant terms or aggregates.

items.name: Dirichlet convolution
items.description: Combine arithmetic functions by divisor/product convolution, often through Dirichlet generating functions.

items.name: Power projection
items.description: Compute selected coefficients across powers of a polynomial or formal power series.

items.name: Floor sum
items.description: Evaluate sums of floor((a*i+b)/m) or equivalent quotient decompositions.

items.name: Binomial coefficient
items.description: Use binomial coefficients, factorial normalization, or modular combinations.

items.name: Gaussian integer
items.description: Reason about factors, norms, or residues in Gaussian integers.

items.name: Prime factorization
items.description: Factor integers and use prime exponents or prime classes in the solution.

items.name: Residue distribution
items.description: Maintain counts or probabilities over residue classes, often modulo one or more dimensions.

items.name: XOR basis
items.description: Build or use a linear basis over XOR values to reduce, test, or optimize bitwise combinations.

items.name: Determinant
items.description: Compute a matrix determinant, often modulo a prime or as part of a graph-counting reduction.

items.name: Matrix exponentiation
items.description: Exponentiate a transition matrix or linear operator to apply many identical DP or automaton steps.

items.name: Aggregate formula
items.description: Use an algebraic formula over maintained aggregates.

items.name: Case reduction
items.description: Reduce many apparent cases to a small set of canonical cases using invariants, recurrences, or normalization.

items.name: Sum and square-sum aggregates
items.description: Maintain or use both sum and sum of squares.

items.name: Interval length
items.description: Compute the number of integers or values in an interval.
